text:
maria-cs: ElmStreet Health onboarding — quick heads up: they need a temporary QPS bump for an EU pilot + IP whitelist for their sync IPs (18.203.12.0/24). They're syncing ~5000 users tomorrow and seeing 429s in staging. Also asked for a 48h soft-quota grace window while we stabilize. Renewal flagged in 6 weeks; smoothing this launch helps retention.

devon-sre: Can you paste the account id + exact IP list? Also which EU region? We need a maintenance window for peering changes.

maria-cs: Account: elmstreet-42. IPs: 18.203.12.0/24, 3.9.88.77/32 (app origin). Target region: eu-west-3. Proposed window: Thu 09:00-12:00 UTC next week.

eliops: For the QPS plan I suggest: bump to 250 QPS for the first 3h, then scale down to 100 QPS. We should enable prefix KV caching for their sync routes to cut token cost. Example config we can apply quickly:

```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate/sync",
  "region": "eu-west-3",
  "qps": 250,
  "burst": 500,
  "ip_whitelist": ["18.203.12.0/24","3.9.88.77/32"],
  "cache_prefix": true
}
```

devon-sre: That looks fine. I'll need two things: confirmation we want the IPs set at the edge or control-plane whitelist, and a peering ticket for eu-west-3. @maria-cs can you confirm whether ElmStreet wants edge egress (lower latency) or just control-plane allowlist (easier)?

maria-cs: They want edge egress for latency reasons. I'll confirm the final contact for net tests and notify them of Thu 09:00 UTC.

onboard-bot: Ticket CS-8901 created (elmstreet-42). Tags: #peering #ip-whitelist #qps-burst. Assigned to devon-sre. ETA: 48h for peering setup.

devon-sre: FYI I'll spin a temporary route and apply the ip_whitelist at the edge. Plan: apply ip rules + QPS bump 30 mins before sync, smoke test with 10k synthetic requests (low concurrency) and then handoff to maria for customer test. If we see >5% 5xx we'll rollback and open incident.

jess-product: I'll schedule a 30min enablement with their engs for Thu 08:00 UTC (prep) and will bring the eval set so we can capture any quality regressions during the burst. Also will add a note to the renewal playbook: 'successful pilot -> discount eligibility'.

maria-cs: Awesome — I'll send the calendar invite and the contact details (ops lead: @tim-elmstreet). Thanks team :raised_hands: 

onboard-bot: CS-8901 updated: ip whitelist submitted to peering team. Status: pending-edge-provision.

devon-sre: I'll post test plan + smoke logs in the ticket once done. @jess-product please add any golden prompts you'd like us to run during the smoke.

maria-cs: Will do. Quick heads up — customer asked whether we can extend the soft-quota grace to 72h if initial sync needs extra retries. Ops ok with 48h; will escalate for 72h if the smoke shows persistent rate issues.

eliops: Noted. Prefer to keep 48h as the default but escalate if necessary. Also adding a perf trace hook for the sync route so we can capture latency percentiles in the first 6h.

maria-cs: Perfect. I'll update the CS playbook and add the renewal note. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
